about: Receipts for src/data/usSeasonLedgerMlb.ts and src/data/usSeasonLedgerNhl.ts: where each fact was read, on what date, and what the source literally says. ap-2016-tie.publisher: The Associated Press, carried by Fox 32 Chicago
ap-2016-tie.title: Cubs-Pirates stopped by rain, first tie in majors since 2005
says: the game won't be made up because it doesn't affect postseason positioning
So instead of becoming a suspended game, the stats count and it was declared a tie
the first since Houston and Cincinnati went seven innings on June 30, 2005, before rain halted them

nbc-2016-tie.title: Rain-shortened Cubs-Pirates game ends in a tie
says: The game was officially suspended in a 1-1 tie and the game will not be made up
Major League Baseball has deemed it a tie game and all stats from the game will count
it's the first tie in baseball since the Astros and Reds on June 30, 2005

ap-2026-finale.publisher: The Associated Press, carried by ABC News and TSN
ap-2026-finale.title: Orioles-Yankees regular-season finale canceled because of rain
says: The regular-season finale between the Baltimore Orioles and New York Yankees on Sunday was canceled because of sustained rain
Baltimore finished 79-82
The Yankees finished 93-68.
This marked the first time since 2002 the Yankees didn't play all 162 games in a non-shortened season.
ap-2026-finale.note: Both copies read today (ABC News and tsn.ca) print 93-68. The scout's note of a 93-67 copy was not found. Neither copy says in words that the game will not be made up; the league's own report by that title could not be opened (its site refused the reader), and the final standings on 161 are the proof.

says: each team will play 13 games against each division rival (52 games)

ticketmaster-2026.title: A Look at the 2026 MLB Schedule and New Rules
says: each team now plays their divisional opponents in only 52 games
13 games in four series against each division rival, seven at home and six away or the reverse (reported by the reader, not quoted)
a total of 26 divisional games at home and 26 away
MLB intraleague play was also shortened to 62 games, down from the previous 66 games.
will consist of six games against eight intraleague teams and seven games against two intraleague teams.
Each team now plays 48 games, up from 20, against teams from the opposite league.
a home-and-home series totaling six games against the natural rival (reported by the reader)
a single, three-game series against the other 14 interleague teams, with seven series at home and seven away

Rival pairs named: Cubs vs. White Sox, Mets vs. Yankees, Angels vs. Dodgers; Astros vs. Rockies; Athletics vs. Giants; Blue Jays vs. Phillies; Guardians vs. Reds; Mariners vs. Padres; Orioles vs. Nationals; Rangers vs. Diamondbacks; Rays vs. Marlins; Red Sox vs. Braves; Royals vs. Cardinals; Tigers vs. Pirates, and Twins vs. Brewers.

mlb-release-2025.publisher: Major League Baseball, press release, as printed by The Highland County Press
mlb-release-2025.title: MLB announces 2025 regular-season schedule
says: For 2025, prime Interleague rivals will increase their number of matchups from four to six
while playing a pair of three-game series rather than a pair of two-game series.
As a result, each of the 30 Clubs will play two fewer games against non-division league opponents.
featuring 11 series between prime Interleague rivals and four other regional matchups which include Pittsburgh vs Philadelphia; Colorado vs. Arizona; Detroit vs. Toronto; and Houston vs. Texas.

mlb-release-2026.publisher: Major League Baseball, press release, as printed by The Highland County Press
mlb-release-2026.title: MLB announces 2026 regular-season schedule
says: Prime Interleague rivals will again play a pair of three-game series against one another in 2026.
In 2026, each of the 30 Clubs will host the same Interleague opponents as they hosted in 2024.
The final day of the 2026 regular season will be Sunday, Sept. 27, featuring nine divisional matchups.
mlb-release-2026.note: The league's own site refuses the reader (HTTP 406 on every address tried), so its releases were read where a newspaper printed them.

espn-2023-format.title: All 30 Major League Baseball teams to play one another in a season for first time in 2023
says: There are 52 total games against divisional opponents, down from 76.
Teams will play six or seven home/road games against divisional opponents.
There are 64 total games -- 32 home and 32 away -- against non-divisional league opponents, down from 66.
Teams will play six games against six league opponents and seven games against four league opponents.
There are 46 total games against interleague opponents, up from just 20.
All 30 MLB teams will be paired with a "natural rival" for a four-game interleague series, with each team hosting two games.
Teams will play 42 games against other interleague opponents, including seven series (21 games) at home and seven series (21 games) on the road.

Pairs: New York Mets-New York Yankees, Chicago Cubs-Chicago White Sox, LA Dodgers-LA Angels, San Francisco Giants-Oakland A's, Cincinnati Reds-Cleveland Guardians, Miami Marlins-Tampa Bay Rays, Washington Nationals-Baltimore Orioles, St. Louis Cardinals-Kansas City Royals, Milwaukee Brewers-Minnesota Twins, Atlanta Braves-Boston Red Sox, Pittsburgh Pirates-Detroit Tigers, Phila. Phillies-Toronto Blue Jays, Arizona D-backs-Texas Rangers, Colorado Rockies-Houston Astros, San Diego Padres-Seattle Mariners

ap-2023-format.publisher: The Associated Press (Ronald Blum), carried by Boston.com
ap-2023-format.title: MLB teams to play all 29 opponents under 2023 balanced schedule
says: A team will play 13 games against each division rival for a total of 52.
six or seven against each other club in its league for a total of 64.
The remaining 46 games are against interleague opponents.
a home and road two-game series against a so-called natural rival
a single three-game series against each of the 14 other clubs in the opposite league.
Natural interleague rivals include Mets-Yankees, Cubs-White Sox, Dodgers-Angels, Giants-Athletics, Reds-Indians, Marlins-Rays, Orioles-Nationals, Royals-Cardinals and Brewers-Twins.
Among the teams with no geographic interleague rivals, MLB paired Red Sox-Braves, Pirates-Tigers, Phillies-Blue Jays, Rangers-Diamondbacks, Astros-Rockies and Padres-Mariners.
ap-2023-format.note: The reader gave the Cleveland pair as Reds-Indians; the club was the Guardians by then, and ESPN's list of the same week prints Guardians.

cbs-2025-playoffs.title: What to know about 2025 MLB playoffs: Format, tiebreakers, rules, seeds, pitch clock, automatic runners, more
says: Each league sends six clubs to the tournament.
The two division winners with the best record in each league earn a first-round bye.
Wild card round: Best-of-three series
Divisional round: Best-of-five series
League Championship round: Best-of-seven series
World Series: Best-of-seven series between AL and NL champion
this is the fourth year since MLB expanded the postseason to 12 teams
teams will not be awarded a runner at second base to begin those frames

ap-2022-playoffs.title: MLB playoff primer: Things to know as postseason nears
says: a field of 12 teams
The best-of-three wild card format
The division series will be best-of-five
the league championship series and World Series will be best-of-seven
the sudden death one-game format
ap-2022-playoffs.note: The page shows no day of publication; the report is of the 2022 postseason.

cbs-2022-playoffs.title: 2022 MLB playoffs: New postseason format explained, and why there are no more Game 163 tiebreakers
says: The field expands from 10 teams to 12.
The two division winners with the best records in each league are rewarded with a first-round bye.
The best-of-three Wild Card Series will be played on three consecutive days.
straight to the best-of-five Division Series
With the addition of the Wild Card Series this year, MLB has done away with Game 163 tiebreakers.
In past years, teams with identical records that tied for a division crown or playoff spot squared off in an extra game to break the tie.

nbcboston-2022-playoffs.title: How to watch MLB postseason, bracket, new format explained
says: In the 12-team format, there will be six playoff teams per league.
The top two seeds will get a bye to the divisional round.
the No. 3 seed will host the No. 6 seed for a three-game series.
will not be any tiebreaker games to determine playoff teams in the 2022 season.

espn-wildcard.title: How does MLB wild card work? Format, history, stats
says: Since 2022, three teams in each league earn a wild-card spot, bringing the total number of playoff teams to 12
MLB introduced the wild card in 1995 along with the realignment of three divisions per league.
a single wild-card team in each league earned a postseason berth ... played the team with the league's best record in a best-of-five series (1995 to 2011)
A second wild-card team was added to each league in 2012, and the two clubs began the postseason with a one-game playoff.
During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, the postseason field was expanded to 16 total teams (eight per league)
The postseason format reverted to two wild-card teams in each league facing off in a single-game playoff in 2021

almanac-postseason.title: MLB Postseason Playoffs 1969 - 2026
says: Section headings: Wildcard Team Era (1994 to 2011), Wildcard Playoff Game (2012 to 2021), Wildcard Series - Modern Playoffs (2022 to 2025)
2004 and 2011: Division Series, League Championship Series, World Series, no wild card round
2012, 2019, 2021: a Wild Card Game first
2020: Wild Card Series (eight of them), then the same three rounds
2022 and 2025: Wild Card Series first
the LCS switched to a best-of-seven series in 1985
In 1995 the playoffs introduced the Division Series.
almanac-postseason.note: It gives no length for a Wild Card Series or a Division Series.

cbs-2023-runner.title: MLB ghost runner rule: League makes extra-innings change permanent for regular-season games, per report
says: a runner is automatically placed at second base to begin each extra inning
MLB first used the extra-innings tiebreaker rule during the 60-game pandemic season in 2020
has voted unanimously to make the rule permanent for the regular season and regular season only.
Postseason games will continue to feature "regular" play in extra innings.

ftw-2024-runner.publisher: For The Win (Charles Curtis), carried by Yahoo Sports
ftw-2024-runner.title: MLB playoffs extra innings rules: Is there a 'ghost runner'? Here's the answer
says: a runner was automatically put on second base to start the 10th and onwards, shortening games.
That's only a regular-season rule that won't be used in the postseason.
ftw-2024-runner.note: For The Win is a USA TODAY title, so it shares USA TODAY's group.
